title: DinneenCraft
description: Pre-reform Modern Irish spelling of Minecraft's Irish translation. Spellings based on the 2nd edition of P.S. Dinneen's Foclóir Gaedhilge agus Béarla (1927).
body:
This resource pack contains a translation of Minecraft into Irish, in the spelling used before the 1950s spelling reform. The spelling conforms to that of the 2nd edition of P.S. Dinneen's _Foclóir Gaedhilge agus Béarla_, but the grammar and vocab is mostly kept the same as the standard Irish translation.

There are two slightly different orthographies available from the language menu in-game:
- _Gaeḋilge (Éire)_ - Uses an overdot to show lenited consonants (e.g. _aġaiḋ_, best with the [Bardchlo](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bardchlo/) resource pack)
- _Gaedhilge (Éire)_ - Uses a following "h" to show lenited consonants, as in modern standard Irish (e.g. _aghaidh_). Best used with the default Minecraft font, Mojangles.

**NOTE:** This modpack does not include a Gaelic font: please download Bardchlo if you want to use Gaelic script letter forms in combination with pre-reform spellings.
